# Reference — Quality gates

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/generate_reference_docs.py from the real code. Do not edit inside this block: rerun the script instead. -->

Generated from validator registration (`default_validators()` plus the
preference validator). Every accepted example must pass the enabled
gates; failures carry machine-readable reason codes routed to review or
quarantine. See [quality concepts](../concepts/quality-gates.md).

| Gate | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `answerability` | C3.5/C4: the prompt must be answerable from the cited evidence. |
| `completeness` | Completeness: answer length is within a sane band of the question+evidence. |
| `format` | Format: assistant should not be empty; JSON-ish answers keep structure. |
| `grounding` | Faithfulness: the assistant answer must be traceable to the evidence. |
| `preference` | C1/D5: preference-pair quality — a genuine, non-fabricated signal. |
| `refusal` | Refusal handling: a refusal must be unanswerable, not a false refusal. |
| `schema` | C3.1/C4: topology-specific structural validation (fail-closed). |
| `semantic_consistency` | Semantic consistency (defect 4.1): atomic claims in the assistant |
